title: SPL freeze authority
detects: A non-null pubkey can freeze any holder's token account, blocking that holder from transferring.
knownFalseNegative: For regulated stablecoin issuers, freeze is a legal requirement rather than a red flag. US permitted issuers are obliged to retain the ability to freeze and seize on lawful order, and Circle has exercised it. Verified on 2026-07-22: USDC and USDT carry active freeze authority. Notably JitoSOL, mSOL and ORCA carry mint authority but NOT freeze, which is a meaningfully different capability profile.

coversExamples.observed: null, mint authority active but freeze is not

rationale: The strongest single capability a Solana token can hold against an individual holder. Also the clearest case where blanket rules fail and issuer context is required.
